"""Port of the per-tenant document store.

No infrastructure or database dependency.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Optional, Protocol, runtime_checkable


@runtime_checkable
class ITenantStorePort(Protocol):
    """Document persistence isolated by tenant."""

    async def read(self, key: str, *, tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> Any:
        """Read the document or list of documents of the key and tenant."""
        ...

    async def write(self, key: str, data: Any, *, tenant_id: Optional[str] = None) -> None:
        """Write or replace the document of the key and tenant."""
        ...
